str.text: The sequence has been aborted. Reason: %1
str.desc: Weld stopped or aborted. %1 = reason for stop/abort.

str.text: The sequence failed during step: %1. Reason: %2
str.desc: The sequence failed while trying to execute an instruction. %1 = instruction name. %2 = reason for failure

str.text: The electrode made contact with the work piece.
str.desc: The execution engine will abort because electrode touched the part.

str.text: The arc went out.
str.desc: The execution engine will abort because arc went out.

str.text: The electrode could not charge.
str.desc: The execution engine will abort because electrode could not charge.

str.text: The system did not sense any trail gas flow.
str.desc: The execution engine will stop because there is no trail gas.

str.text: The system did not sense any backup gas flow.
str.desc: The execution engine will stop because there is no backup gas.

str.text: The system did not sense any plasma gas flow.
str.desc: The execution engine will stop because there is no plasma gas.

str.text: The system did not sense any shield gas flow.
str.desc: The execution engine will abort because there is no shield gas.

str.text: The system did not sense any coolant flow.
str.desc: The execution engine will stop because there is no cooler flow.

str.text: No Hotwire Amps.
str.desc: A detail to be added to another message. The execution engine will stop because there is no hotwire amps.

str.text: The pre-start check has failed. Reason: %1
str.desc: A pre weld check failed to weld could not start. %1 = reason for not starting

str.text: The %1 telemetry (%2) went outside of the acceptable range of %3 to %4. To view and adjust the acceptable ranges, use the LIMITS screen.
str.desc: The execution engine will stop because the parameter telemetry deviated from the fault threshold values. %1 = parameter name. %2 = parameter telemetry. %3 = fault threshold lower limit. %4 = fault threshold upper limit.

str.text: Please navigate to the weld area to begin a weld.
str.desc: Navigate to the weld area to begin a weld.

str.text: The internal temperature of the power supply is too hot to safely weld.
str.desc: The execution engine will stop because the power supply's internal temperature exceeded the max threshold allowed for welding.

str.text: There are no segments enabled in the schedule. Enable at least one segment before starting again.
A weld has been started while Trace Logs are enabled. Welding performance may be heavily impacted.
str.desc: The user has started a weld while the system is collecting Trace Log diagnostics data. This can lead to performance issues with the weld.

str.text: There are too many instructions included in the weld schedule. Please reduce the loop count or the number of enabled segments in the schedule and start again.
str.desc: The user has included more segments than the system can handle. They need to reduce the number of segments before they can attempt to start the weld again.

str.text: Unable to establish an arc.
str.desc: The execution engine will fail because arc was not established.

str.text: A weld has been started with a scratch/manual arc start.
str.desc: The user has started a weld with arc start type selected as Scratch arc.
